about: The Haftarah from the Prophets (1 Kings 7:40–50) lists the furnishings Solomon made for the house of the LORD, ending with the golden lampstands before the inner sanctuary. The reading from the Apostles (Matthew 5:14–20) carries that light into the lives of Yeshua’s disciples: they are the light of the world, a lamp set on its stand rather than hidden.

Note: The printed journal may have mistakenly listed last Shabbat’s readings here (Zechariah 2:10–4:7 and John 10:22–38). On the second Shabbat of Hanukkah the traditional Haftarah is 1 Kings 7:40–50, read here with Matthew 5:14–20 from the Apostles.
